items.prompt:
Potential energy is:
A) Energy of motion
B) Stored energy based on position or arrangement
C) A kind of sound
D) Only found in magnets
items.answer: B) Stored energy based on position or arrangement

steps: Potential energy is stored energy depending on position or arrangement.

items.prompt:
Gravitational potential energy depends on an object's height and:
A) Color
B) Mass
C) Name
D) Speed

steps: Height and mass determine gravitational potential energy.

items.prompt:
Lifting a ball to a higher shelf makes its gravitational potential energy:
A) Decrease
B) Increase
C) Disappear
D) Turn to sound

Two identical balls are held at different heights. The higher ball has:
A) Less potential energy
B) More potential energy
C) No potential energy
D) The same potential energy

steps: More height means more gravitational potential energy.

items.prompt:
A compressed spring stores:
A) Kinetic energy
B) Elastic potential energy
C) No energy
D) Sound energy

steps: Compressed or stretched objects store elastic potential energy.

items.prompt:
A heavier ball and a lighter ball at the same height: which has more gravitational potential energy?
A) The lighter ball
B) The heavier ball
C) Both equal
D) Neither

steps: More mass means more gravitational potential energy.

items.prompt:
When a lifted book falls, its energy changes from:
A) Kinetic to potential
B) Potential to kinetic
C) Sound to light
D) None to none

steps: Stored gravitational potential energy converts into kinetic energy as it falls.

items.prompt:
Why does changing the arrangement of two interacting magnets change the stored energy?
A) Potential energy depends on how objects are arranged
B) Magnets have no energy
C) Only motion stores energy
D) Arrangement never matters
items.answer: A) Potential energy depends on how objects are arranged

steps: Potential energy depends on the position/arrangement of interacting objects.
